The fourth edition of the **INDEMIC Seminar Series** featured **Dr Neilshan Loedy**, a researcher at the Data Science Institute (DSI), Hasselt University (UHasselt), Belgium. Neilshan recently completed his PhD at UHasselt under the supervision of **Prof Niel Hens** — congratulations, Neilshan!

He presented his work on **"Statistical methods for analyzing respiratory infectious diseases using social contact data"**, exploring how data on human mixing patterns can be combined with statistical and epidemiological models to better understand and predict the spread of respiratory pathogens.
